entities.name: 3rd Party
entities.rationale: External software and drone system labeled 3rd Party on the left side of the diagram.

entities.name: CloudWatch Event
entities.rationale: CloudWatch Event icon triggers scheduled events for processing.

entities.name: Step Functions
entities.rationale: Step Functions orchestrates execution of Lambda functions.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda icon processing image files, calling 3rd party API, and creating raster proxies.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: S3 bucket icon used for storing processed drone imagery.

entities.name: Storage Gateway
entities.rationale: Storage Gateway icon enabling on-premises server access to S3 storage.

entities.name: Server
entities.rationale: On-premises server icon located inside the on-premise container box on the right.

entities.name: Database
entities.rationale: On-premises database icon located inside the on-premise container box on the right below the server.

visual_connections.description: Curved green arrow showing imagery data transfer from 3rd Party to S3.
Green arrow from CloudWatch Event triggering Step Functions.
Green arrow from Step Functions triggering Lambda execution.
Green arrow labeled API pointing from Lambda to 3rd Party.
Green arrow from Lambda pointing up to S3 bucket.
Green arrow from Lambda pointing to on-premises Database.
Green arrow from Server pointing to Storage Gateway.
Green arrow pointing from Storage Gateway to S3.
